I sent Pree a DM listing four Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and where each came from:

- **#4409 and #4412:** from Moss's public "Central handoffs next week" digest (2 Jan 2026). They were the two open tickets flagged before the account changed hands on 5 Jan.
- **#8841:** from #central-random, posted by Tobias on 13 Oct. That message says "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I counted it because Moss's digest calls Fieldworks the dealer account and shows it changing hands, but that's my inference. I told Pree to check with Tobias if she needs to be sure.
- **PD-5302:** from #central-random, posted by Hollis on 14 Oct, so it's from this week. It's a follow-up ticket that needs no action.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. I found no other Fieldworks tickets in Moss's Central cheat sheet, #central-team or Pree's DM with me.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: two channels she belongs to (#central-random and #central-team), public files, and her DM with me. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.

The GBrain lookup ran in keyword-only mode, so it may have missed notes worded differently. Its hits were copies of the same public files and channels I read directly.
